title: An option in the middle
hook: Two stated cases: explore a stated net comparison after the menu changes.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How a stated net comparison after the menu changes affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines NetGap, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare a stated net comparison after the menu changes in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
